submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires when the current token itself spells meet, meets, meeting or met (case-insensitive, ignoring leading space) or starts with the prefix met- or meet- as a subword piece (e.g. the 'met' of metrology, metered, metaphilosophy). The same pole also fires on the quantifier any or Any on its own token; surrounding words do not change the response.

top_examples.text:
What is ulcerative colitis?
Ulcerative colitis is inflammation or irritation of the lining of the colon, which starts in the rectum. This shows up on endoscopic exams as a diffuse redness that may have spontaneous bleeding or mucus on the surface. Discrete ulcers are not seen visually although they are readily seen under the microscope. The most common area to be affected is the rectum (this may be called ulcerative proctitis). In time it may advance higher in the colon or it may start with the entire colon being diseased. Inflammation and scar tissue (sclerosing cholangitis) can affect the bile ducts. Liver disease or pericholangitis occurs occasionally. As part of the overall ulcerative colitis disease, 5% of people experience joint and low back pain, a variety of skin and eye diseases, fever and anemia.
What is the cause for ulcerative colitis?
Although no one knows what starts this disease, many aspects of the inflammatory process are known. There appears to be a genetic predisposition to the disease. Ulcerative colitis may start after a gastrointestinal infection where certain inflammatory cells get stimulated and stay that way for uncertain reasons.
What is the long-term outlook for people with ulcerative colitis?
This disease becomes active and goes into remission without any predictability. After a person gets into a drug-induced remission, relapse occurs in 25-50% after 1 year and 40-65% after 2 years. Approximately one third to one half of people with ulcerative colitis require surgery to remove the colon. In surgical cases, an internal intestinal pouch can be created so there is no external bag or ostomy. When the colitis has been extensive the risk for colon cancer starts to increase after having the disease for a period of 7-10 years. After this time period approximately 1% of patients per year develop colon cancer. Undergoing a regular surveillance program with colonoscopy and biopsies can prevent cancer. If a biopsy shows evidence of dysplasia, colon surgery can prevent cancer.
What is the treatment for ulcerative colitis?
Usually the first treatment is one of the 6-ASA medications: Asacol, Rowasa, Pentasa, Dipentum, Colazal and Azulfidine. Colazal has been shown in a recent study to be more effective and better tolerated than Asacol in the treatment of ulcerative colitis. This class of medications decreases mucosal permeability, inhibits antibody production, inhibits chemotactic factor production and stimulates prostaglandin production. For moderate or severe disease, an anti-inflammatory steroid called prednisone is commonly prescribed. This drug is similar to a chemical that our own body makes but when used in high doses it has many short-term and long-term side effects. A third class of medications called immunosuppressant's or immunomodulating medications are useful in minimizing the dose or replacing the use of steroids. What was the reason for the low efficiency of the conspirators? In our efforts to answer this question, historians often begin to talk about the diabolical luck of the Führer. And, sometimes, about the complex multi-echelon security system developed by Hitler’s Chief of Safety, Hans Rattenhuber.
The very same Fuhrer, however, wrote: «I am aware of why ninety percent of the historical attempts were unsuccessful. The only preventive measures that should be taken should have the same similarities of every day life, such as walking, traveling and moving around. All of this should take place at its normal pace and with the same spontaneity as every day life.
Gerhrad Meyer will face the enormous power of the Führer’s security in the second chapter of the game, and that is the time when he would try to lay the explosives directly on the Fuhrers plane.
For his flight travel Hitler always used the heavy four machine-type «Condor» company «Fokke-Wolf». The personal pilot of the Fuhrer was Lieutenant-General Hans Bauer, the commander of a special aviation wing, serving all of the top brass of the Third Reich. The cruising speed of the «Condor» amounted to 340 kilometers per hour, and the duration of the flight was four hours. The crew never flew above 4.5 thousand meters because at that altitude Hitler would become sick.
To defend itself, the «Condor» was armed with two heavy 150 mm machine guns, one in the back in the plane’s tail, and another one under the fuselage. During the flight to the front line, Hitler’s plane was accompanied by an escort of fighters ranging from 6 to 10 vehicles, manned by the best of Germany’s aces.
The same airplane had a special device that high-ranking passengers could open in an emergency by pressing a special button. A passanger chair was attached to the parachute, which opened automatically a few seconds after the start of the free fall began. The device, and especially the parachute, were continuously subjected to special technical inspection. But the Fuhrer, fortunately for him, never was in a position to take advantage of this …

Create a buyer experience of a special kind: SaleSphere is the multimedia product catalog for your sales department. Through innovative and dynamic presentations and clear management of customer and product information, you can also make complex products more accessible to your customers – and keep your customer in mind!
Videos, presentations and pictures – Stand out from analogue and classic sales and set an example – Digitize your sales with the SaleSphere App today!
Increase your customer experience with SaleSphere! The Sales App gives you access to all relevant customer and product information – anytime, anywhere, even offline! All the information you need for a convincing sales pitch, you keep in a single medium at hand, your tablet-pc. In addition to texts, tables, documents, multimedia contents such as pictures, graphics, videos or 360° drawings can be integrated directly into your customer presentation, making your products tangible. Of course, the intuitively designed presentation interface can be easily adapted to your corporate identity, which gives you the intended brand message from the first customer contact.
All relevant data always available – even offline.
Your products and services are presented in a clear manner by product categories in tiles, with all the relevant information (such as detail views, datasheets, lists, graphics, etc.). In order to have access to all relevant product information on site, there are numerous connections to various ERP-, CRM- and PIM-Systems. Intelligent search functions (including search inside documents) also help you to find what your customers really need, very fast. Furthermore, fully defined filter processes can be carried out using defined tags. You can always present professionally, even with bad internet connections, because the multimedia product catalog also works in offline mode.
The clear, product-oriented and graphical presentation interface enables quick orientation in the system. Graphical elements such as windows, tiles, dialogs and menus ensure easy editing of input via the tablet and ensure intuitive communication. Conversational processes can be individually structured.
With SaleSphere you always have access to the most up-to-date data. PDF catalogs, brochures, pictures, sales lists, videos and technical drawings are always available and easily accessible, even in offline mode. If product data or information change, the new files are automatically imported to SaleSphere through third-party connectivity. Customers and prospects are thus always advised with the latest information.
Product and customer data available digitally – also offline!
The SaleSphere App’s multimedia product catalog offers numerous features that will strengthen your sales in the long term: from product and service information with intelligent search functions, detail views and data Sheets, presentations and videos to offers and orders, all data are clearly displayed and available at anytime – even offline.

1. Field of the Invention
The present invention relates generally to a liquid-based Pap test and, more particularly, to an apparatus and method for removing cells from an endocervical brush utilized to obtain a specimen for testing.
2. Description of Related Art
Detection and diagnosis of a variety of diseases, such as cancer, often involves the collection and microscopic examination of a cell sample. Such cell samples, as in the Papanicolaou (xe2x80x9cPapxe2x80x9d) test, are typically collected from a patient with a type of cytology sampling device. Such sampling devices include various types of brushes (e.g., the Cervix-brush made by Rovers of Oss, The Netherlands and the Cytobrush made by Medscand of Malmo, Sweden) and spatulas (e.g., the Szalay spatula made by C.S.M. Graf and Co., of Steinach Switzerland, the Papex spatula made by Hengstberger of Vienna Austria, and the WrGKK spatula utilized by the main social security in Vienna, Austria), as well as cotton swabs and loop-type devices.
In the case of brush type sampling devices, the cell samples must be transferred after collection from the bristles of the brush to a glass slide that allows for the examination of the cells. In order to obtain the best diagnosis, it is imperative that the cell samples be completely and accurately transferred from the brush to the testing medium. Not only can this affect the diagnosis, but women may be reluctant to have the procedure repeated when an inadequate sample is taken. It will be understood that an inadequate sample may include the instance where no abnormal cells are transferred to the glass slide, which results in false negatives that go unnoticed.
In particular, it will be appreciated that a liquid-based Pap test is growing in use by many doctors and labs. This involves the cell sample being transferred from the brush to a fixative or preservative within a vial or other container. One example of an FDA-approved liquid based preparation product is the ThinPrep(copyright) Pap Test(trademark) (xe2x80x9cTPPTxe2x80x9d) made by Cytyc Corporation of Boxborough, Massachusetts. As seen in the protocol for the TPPT, which is described in a ThinPrep(copyright) Pap Test Quick Reference Guide (1997), the brush is rotated vigorously while being pushed against the vial wall in order to release the cell sample in the solution. It will be appreciated, however, that pushing the cytology brush against the vial wall can have the detrimental effect of compacting the cell sample to the bristles. Additionally, the brush may not even touch the vial wall if the shaft of the brush is held in a certain way.
While the protocol set forth in the TPPT has been successful in gaining approval from the Food and Drug Administration. it has been found to be very operator dependent and results could be improved if a greater release of the cell sample from the brush is accomplished.
